proposition: Ibn Turka wrote briefly to members of Herat's religious and financial establishment: Shaykh al-Islām Shams al-Dīn Muḥammad Taftāzānī (letter 7, and the greeting in 3), the Chishtī administrator of Shāhrukh's madrasa-khanaqah (3), and the chief ṣadr Jalāl al-Dīn Luṭf Allāh, whom he calls sulṭān al-ʿulamāʾ (41, 42).

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, writing to Herat religious officials
mediation.note: Letters to third parties ask or offer favours; the text survives only in copies made after his lifetime (except the marginal letters in MS Majlis 10196).

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, summarising, dating and identifying the letter(s)
mediation.note: Identification of the Shams al-Dīn Muḥammad addressed is MK's 'presumably'
